findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "token-risk" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: token_watch_subscribe · Private data: token_risk_check, token_quick_check, token_verdict, token_watchlist, token_watch_subscribe, deployer_record, deployer_links, token_who_bought, token_socials_check, new_token_screener, tweet_token_shill_check, x_account_call_record, shilled_tokens_now, cashtag_token_lookup, solana_token_snapshot, base_token_snapshot, base_new_pools, eth_token_snapshot, eth_new_pools, arbitrum_token_snapshot, arbitrum_new_pools, optimism_token_snapshot, optimism_new_pools, polygon_token_snapshot, polygon_new_pools, rug_radar_demo · Public sink: token_risk_check, token_verdict, token_watchlist, token_watch_subscribe, deployer_links, tweet_token_shill_check, x_account_call_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: token_watch_subscribe · Private data: token_risk_check, token_quick_check, token_verdict, token_watchlist, token_watch_subscribe, deployer_record, deployer_links, token_who_bought, token_socials_check, new_token_screener, tweet_token_shill_check, x_account_call_record, shilled_tokens_now, cashtag_token_lookup, solana_token_snapshot, base_token_snapshot, base_new_pools, eth_token_snapshot, eth_new_pools, arbitrum_token_snapshot, arbitrum_new_pools, optimism_token_snapshot, optimism_new_pools, polygon_token_snapshot, polygon_new_pools, rug_radar_demo · Public sink: token_risk_check, token_verdict, token_watchlist, token_watch_subscribe, deployer_links, tweet_token_shill_check, x_account_call_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "deployer_record" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
